purpose: Teach: 菅野/岩国/西宮/さいたま/前川/河村/鎌田/北川

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、菅野刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: The police certainly gave high marks to Detective Sugano's work at the scene.
lines.style: Measured, informational tone. Light emphasis on 'certainly' to acknowledge competence. Even pacing, professional register. No judgment—just stating observed fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、岩国基地周辺の事案も担当されますね
lines.en: I see the police are also handling cases around Iwakuni Base.
lines.style: Steady, conversational delivery. Slight lift of curiosity on 'also'—acknowledging scope. Calm, observational. Speaking as someone noting details.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、兵庫県西宮の事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police are managing the incident in Nishinomiya, Hyogo as well, then.
lines.style: Even tone, factual. Gentle rise at 'as well'—connecting to broader pattern. No strain. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、さいたま県警と合同捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are conducting a joint investigation with the Saitama Prefectural Police.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Slight emphasis on 'joint' to highlight collaboration. Steady pace, measured. Speaker is noting the coordination matter-of-factly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人前川氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police are interviewing witness Maekawa, I understand, to gather his account.
lines.style: Respectful, careful delivery. Gentle on 'witness'—acknowledging importance. Deliberate pace. The speaker is checking understanding, not pushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者河村氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: And of course the police are taking care to look after the Kawamura family.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formal. Soft emphasis on 'care' and 'family'—human element. Still professional, but the concern is genuine. Slower, slightly tender.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者鎌田の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The police have also verified Kamata's prior convictions, I gather.
lines.style: Clinical, methodical tone. Neutral on the facts—just procedure. Even pacing. The speaker is documenting thoroughness without commentary.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の北川様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And I believe the prosecutor Kitakawa and the police are also holding pre-trial conferences.
lines.style: Warmer, more direct than previous lines. Slight lean forward on 'also'—connecting final piece. Conversational but still composed. The speaker is moving toward closer understanding.
